verdict.rationale: The docs cover only fragments of a security posture. `init --dry-run` previews which skill files will be written before anything changes, the `--path` local project context is said to stay local during retrieval, and MCP access is gated by scopes such as `context:protected:read`. There is no consolidated security document, no statement of what skills may execute, no trust model for third-party skills, and no telemetry or data-collection disclosure. Missing for 10: a documented skill execution/permission boundary, a trust model for third-party skills, a telemetry/data-collection policy, and a dedicated security or privacy page with independent corroboration.
